heard: Two continent-sized blobs of an alien planet are buried deep inside Earth. Most people believe the Moon slowly formed from orbiting debris over millions of years. 4.5 billion years ago, a Mars-sized world named Theia smashed into our infant Earth. Recent high-resolution simulations reveal this cataclysmic impact could have formed the Moon in just a few hours. But Theia did not vanish entirely into space. Two massive iron-rich anomalies sit 1,800 miles deep beneath Africa and the Pacific Ocean. Scientists identify these dense structures as the ancient mantle relics of Theia. Two continent-sized blobs of that ancient world are still buried deep inside Earth.
